title: Understanding the Feature Encoding
text: The feature encoding should represent the time of day in a way that captures the cyclical nature of time. Consider how time is typically represented in a 24-hour format.

title: Logarithmic Transformation
text: The logarithmic transformation is often used to handle skewed data. However, consider whether it is appropriate for encoding time of day, which is inherently cyclical.

title: Evaluating the Code
text: Evaluate the expression $$\ln\left(12time_{of,day}\right)$$. Does this expression correctly encode the cyclical nature of time?
